regions.merged_text: God bless you Miss Grace Panyard, I was just in at my Hour and thought of my promise of the leaflets etc. Here they are and I am sure you will like them. Please tell Doris that it is three 3: 15 P.M. a little after that we expect that Fatima - Statue of Our B1. Mother Mary to arrive here at the Monastery, in case she's in the neighborhood.
